findings.summary: Soundness: bullet extraction reads an `Acceptance:` heading inside quoted evidence (code fences), so a steward-approved request is checked against another job's bullets
findings.evidence: The parser uses the first line equal to 'Acceptance:' anywhere in the request and does not skip fenced code blocks. Recorded request 20261102-001719-1fva (evidence records/jobs/2026-11/20261102-001719-1fva/request.json) is a steward-approved request with no acceptance section of its own. Its Evidence section quotes job 20261031-031749-am9j's request inside ``` fences, including an 'Acceptance:' list about plan_rebase and a bare-origin test. 1fva's reading (reading-1.json) is about D87 and the watcher, so the check refuses it for bullets it was never asked to meet. The producer's replay lists 1fva among its 8 refusals. Simpler fix: ignore lines inside code fences (or stop at an '## Evidence' heading) when finding the heading and bullets, and add a corpus case of this shape.

findings.summary: The CHANGELOG and doc comment misstate the replay: they present 1fva as a real omission
findings.evidence: The CHANGELOG says jobs 199q and 1fva 'were read in full: each reading leaves out a bullet of its request, ... the second the bare-origin test'. The bare-origin bullet belongs to job 20261031-031749-am9j, quoted as evidence in 1fva's request, not to 1fva. 199q is a real omission: its reading has no criterion for the 'next throughput review shows the median ... falling' bullet. So 1 of the 2 checked refusals is a false positive, and the measured rate of 8/793 counts wrong refusals as intended ones.

findings.summary: The threshold is tuned on one omitted example with a 3-point margin
findings.evidence: The tuning test prints 'omitted sza7 bullet 22%, lowest covered bullet 42%' against COVERAGE_MIN_PERCENT = 25. With one more or one fewer stem in that bullet, 2 matches would reach 25% and the motivating omission would be accepted. More recorded omissions, such as 199q, would make the bound sturdier.

findings.summary: The steward pointer special case matches 'as described:' anywhere in a bullet
findings.evidence: `if text.contains("as described:")` returns no stems for any bullet containing the phrase. A user bullet such as 'The output is formatted as described: ...' would never be checked. Matching the exact generated prefix from steward.rs:621 ('The change is made as described:') would be narrower.

findings.summary: One run of the athena-core suite exited 101 with no visible cause and did not repeat
findings.evidence: My first `cargo test -p athena-core -- --nocapture` exited 101 and its output was cut off, so I could not see the failing test. `cargo test -p athena-core -q` and `cargo test -p athena-core -q -- --nocapture` both passed (1305 passed, 1 ignored), and CI passed. This is probably a flaky test unrelated to the change, but that is not confirmed.

summary: The check is wired in as one step! line, uses the real recorded sza7, ttnw and bp5e text (checked word for word against the evidence snapshot), and its unit and corpus tests pass. I ran `cargo test -p athena-core coverage -- --nocapture` and `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`. The candidate still fails on soundness. The bullet parser takes the first `Acceptance:` heading anywhere in the request, including one inside a quoted code block. Requests approved from the steward copy other jobs' requests into an Evidence section. Recorded job 20261102-001719-1fva has no acceptance heading of its own, yet its reading would be refused for not covering the bullets of a different job (20261031-031749-am9j) quoted in its evidence. The producer's own replay lists 1fva as newly refused, and the CHANGELOG wrongly calls it a real omission of "the bare-origin test", which is a bullet of the other job. So a newly refused reading that covers all of its own bullets exists, and criterion 7 is unmet. Smaller issues: the threshold margin is thin (the omitted bullet scores 22% against a 25% threshold), the "as described:" special case is loose, and one run of the athena-core suite exited 101 without a visible cause and passed on two reruns.
